_doc: Which OS-MOAP packages track an Alpine upstream (version ORACLE only -- Alpine ships no wasm binaries; we rebuild from upstream source with guest/pkgs/<name>/build.sh). Consumed by os-moap-repo's track-alpine workflow. Untracked local ports: hello, shellver, webby, curses-smoke. ncurses is a static build-dep of nano/sl, not published; manual bumps.
